query_text: Recommend high-quality cookware brands for serious home cooks. Name several specific brands.
response_text:
Here are several high-quality cookware brands well-regarded by serious home cooks:

## Stainless Steel
- **All-Clad** - American-made, industry standard for tri-ply construction
- **Demeyere** - Belgian brand, excellent heat distribution
- **Made In** - Newer brand offering professional quality at lower prices

## Cast Iron & Carbon Steel
- **Le Creuset** - Premium enameled cast iron, excellent heat retention
- **Staub** - French enameled cast iron, known for self-basting lids
- **Lodge** - Affordable American cast iron, great value
- **de Buyer** - French carbon steel, restaurant favorite

## Nonstick
- **Scanpan** - Danish brand with durable PFOA-free coating
- **GreenPan** - Ceramic nonstick option

## Copper
- **Mauviel** - French copper cookware, exceptional responsiveness
- **Ruffoni** - Italian, both functional and decorative

## Multi-Purpose/Value
- **Tramontina** - Brazilian brand, excellent quality-to-price ratio
- **Cuisinart** - Reliable mid-range option

The best choice depends on your cooking style, budget, and what you cook most often. Many serious cooks build collections across multiple brands rather than buying matching sets.
